Maria (People Ops): Quick problem — a few interviewers completed the "Panel Interviewer" training but the ATS still marks them as 'not cleared'. Can we triage?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I saw one case. The LMS webhook posts fine but our ingestion service fails silently on email mismatches.
Priya (Learning): LMS shows completions for nate+pdl@personal.io and rita@workmail.com at 08:30. We used the email they provided during signup.
Ashley (SRE): Any errors in our webhook logs?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Logs show 200 from ATS endpoint, then a DB unique constraint when upserting flags for users not fully provisioned yet. The ingestion doesn't retry.
Lee (Recruiter): We're blocked scheduling panels for those hires. Can we manually flip flags for the affected users?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Manual is possible but risky at scale. Short fix: Priya requeue the three webhook deliveries; Ashley add a retry on unique-violation in ingestion for a quick patch.
Priya (Learning): Requeued now for nate and rita. Also noted in training docs to use corporate email where possible.
integration-bot: webhook.requeue payloads=2 users=["nate+pdl@personal.io","rita@workmail.com"]
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Replays created flags for rita but nate still failed because his ATS account is under nate@company.com (alias). Our ingestion only checks primary email.
Ashley (SRE): I'll deploy a tiny ingestion change to check the email_aliases table on lookup and retry on constraint error. Low-risk patch, 10m window.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I'll add ticket REQ-4022 to make the webhook idempotent and enhance alias matching. Also will manually add nate's alias mapping so the replay succeeds.
Lee (Recruiter): Nate is clear now, can assign interviews. Thanks.
Maria (People Ops): Great. Actions: Ashley deploys retry+alias check (in progress), Sam files enhancement ticket and creates runbook step to verify training->ATS linkage during onboarding, Priya updates training signup guidance. Target to close today.
Ashley (SRE): Patch deployed and tested, ingestion now handles alias lookups and retries. Monitoring OK.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Filed REQ-4022 and added onboarding checklist item. Moving this thread to resolved.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll notify hiring managers that the pipeline is cleared.
